title: Factions and Major Projects
source: Worlds Without Number Deluxe, Factions and Major Projects (pp.326-347)

rules.attribute_check: Attacker and defender each roll 1d10 + relevant attribute. The attacker wins only if their total is higher; the defender wins on a tie or a higher roll. Extra-die abilities roll more dice and keep the highest.
rules.initiative: At the start of every faction turn each faction rolls 1d8; highest goes first, GM breaks ties.
rules.treasure_income: Each turn a faction earns Treasure equal to half its Wealth plus a quarter of its combined Force and Cunning, rounded up.
turn_sequence: Earn Treasure (half Wealth + quarter of (Force+Cunning), round up).
Pay upkeep for Asset costs and for excess Assets (1 Treasure per Asset over an attribute's rating); unpaid excess Assets are lost.
Trigger any special Asset abilities (movement, profit, etc.).
Take ONE Faction Action; every valid owned Asset performs it.
Check the current goal: if met, collect its XP and pick a new goal; if not, may abandon it for a new one at the cost of next turn's action + abilities.
rules.hp_formula: Max HP = sum of the HP values for the faction's Force, Cunning, and Wealth ratings (rating 1=1, 2=2, 3=4, 4=6, 5=9, 6=12, 7=16, 8=20). The HQ Base of Influence always has HP equal to the faction maximum.

actions.Attack: Nominate Assets to attack enemy Assets in their location; the defender picks which Asset meets each attack. Roll the acting Asset's attribute check; on success deal its attack score, on failure take the defender's counterattack. Damage to a Base of Influence is also dealt to faction HP (no overflow).
actions.Move Asset: Move one or more Assets up to one turn's movement (~100 mi/month). The destination must not forbid the Asset; Subtle/Stealthed ignore this. An Asset that loses Subtle/Stealth in a hostile location must retreat within one turn or take half its max HP in damage.
actions.Repair Asset: Spend 1 Treasure per Asset to heal half its relevant attribute (round up); further fixes that turn cost +1 each. Once/turn may also heal faction HP for 1 Treasure equal to (highest + lowest of F/W/C) / 2, round up.
actions.Expand Influence: Plant a new Base of Influence where you already have an Asset; pay 1 Treasure per HP it will have. Then make a Cunning vs. Cunning check against each rival with an Asset present; a winner may immediately Attack the new base.
actions.Create Asset: Buy one Asset at a Base of Influence you own; you must meet its attribute + Magic requirements and pay its cost. One Asset per turn. No more Assets of an attribute than its rating, or pay 1 Treasure/excess per turn.
actions.Hide Asset: Cunning 3+ only. Give an owned Asset the Stealth quality for every 2 Treasure spent. Assets in a location with a rival Base can't be hidden; no refund if Stealth is later lost.
actions.Sell Asset: Decommission an Asset for half its purchase cost (round down). A damaged Asset yields no Treasure.
actions.Use Asset Ability: In place of another action, use an Asset ability that replaces the Attack action (e.g. Cryptomancers, Seditionists). Free-action abilities fire in the trigger step regardless of the chosen action.

major_projects.currency: Renown — earned ~1 per adventure (plus bonus Renown for relevant work), spent to buy down a project's difficulty.
major_projects.difficulty: Difficulty = base (Plausible 1 / Improbable 2 / Impossible 4) x scope multiplier (Village x2 / City x4 / Region x8 / Kingdom x16 / Known World x32) x opposition multiplier (Minor figures x2 / Local leaders x4 / Major noble or beast x8 / King or famed monster x16). x2 again if the local population is emotionally against it.
major_projects.reduce: Lower difficulty by spending money (Renown bought at rising silver cost: first 1-4 pts 500/pt, next 4 at 2000, next 8 at 4000, next 16 at 8000, next 32 at 16000, next 64 at 32000), building institutions, nullifying opposition (only the greatest opponent counts), or adventuring toward the goal (the most efficient route).
major_projects.faction_help: A faction may aid a project once per faction turn as its action: spend 1 Treasure and lower the difficulty by its total Force + Cunning + Wealth (doubled if ideally suited), to a minimum of 1. It may also burn Asset/Base HP 1-for-1 to lower difficulty, then each contributing Asset/Base takes +1d4 damage.

domains.property_tax: Owners of property on land controlled by another power pay ~5% of its total worth per year to the local ruler (titled nobles are often exempt).
domains.construction: A skilled artisan-mason builds 25 sp of structure per labor-day (unskilled 5 sp/day). Sample costs: keep on the borderlands 50,000 sp; military watchtower 5,000 sp; minor lord's landholdings 25,000 sp; major noble's 200,000 sp.
domains.upkeep: Garrisons and households cost monthly wages (e.g. light infantry 40 sp, heavy infantry 60 sp, archer 75 sp, light cavalry 100 sp, heavy cavalry 200 sp; reeve/spymaster/majordomo 200-500 sp). Long-term housing halves a hireling's or soldier's monthly price.

entries.value: Antimagical: Dwarven or other skilled counter-sorcerers. Assets that require Medium or higher Magic to purchase roll all attribute checks twice against this faction during an Attack and take the worst roll.
Concealed: All Assets the faction purchases enter play with the Stealth quality.
Imperialist: Once per turn it can use the Expand Influence action as a free special ability instead of it taking a full action.
Innovative: Can purchase Assets as if their attribute ratings were two points higher than they are. Only two such over-complex Assets may be owned at any one time.
Machiavellian: Diabolically cunning. Rolls an extra die for all Cunning attribute checks. Its Cunning must always be its highest attribute.
Martial: Devoted to war. Rolls an extra die for all Force attribute checks. Force must always be its highest attribute.
Massive: An empire or huge edifice. Automatically wins attribute checks if its attribute is more than twice the opposing side's, unless the other side is also Massive.
Mobile: Exceptionally fast. Its faction-turn movement range is twice what another faction would have in the same situation.
Populist: Widespread popular support. Assets costing 5 Treasure or less to buy cost one point less, to a minimum of 1.
Rich: Rich or mercantile. Rolls an extra die for all Wealth attribute checks. Wealth must always be its highest attribute.
Rooted: Deep roots in its area. Rolls an extra die for checks in its headquarters; all rivals roll their checks there twice and take the worst die.
Scavenger: When it destroys an enemy Asset it gains a quarter of that Asset's purchase value in Treasure, rounded up.
Supported: Excellent logistics. All damaged Assets except Bases of Influence regain one lost hit point per faction turn automatically.
Tenacious: Hard to dislodge. When one of its Bases of Influence is reduced to zero HP it instead survives with 1 HP. Not usable again on that base until fully fixed.
Zealot: Once per turn, when an Asset fails an Attack action check, it can reroll the check. It automatically takes the target's counterattack damage, or 1d6 if the target has less or none.

Blood the Enemy (Difficulty 2): Inflict HP of damage on enemy faction assets/bases equal to your faction's total Force + Cunning + Wealth ratings.
Destroy the Foe (Difficulty 2 + avg(F,C,W)): Destroy a rival faction. Difficulty equals 2 plus the average of the faction's Force, Cunning, and Wealth ratings.
Eliminate Target (Difficulty 1): Choose an undamaged rival Asset; destroy it within three turns. On failure, pick a new goal without the usual turn of paralysis.
Expand Influence (Difficulty 1 (+1 if contested)): Plant a Base of Influence at a new location.

Inside Enemy Territory (Difficulty 2): Have a number of Stealthed assets in locations with a rival Base of Influence equal to your Cunning. Already-Stealthed units when the goal is adopted don't count.
Invincible Valor (Difficulty 2): Destroy a Force asset whose minimum purchase rating is higher than your faction's Force rating.
Peaceable Kingdom (Difficulty 1): Don't take an Attack action for four turns.
Root Out the Enemy (Difficulty half avg(ruler F,C,W), round up): Destroy a Base of Influence of a rival faction in a specific location.
Sphere Dominance (Difficulty 1 per 2 destroyed, round up): Choose Wealth, Force, or Cunning; destroy a number of rival assets of that kind equal to your score in it.
Wealth of Kingdoms (Difficulty 2): Spend Treasure equal to four times your Wealth on bribes and influence (lost). Wealth must rise before this goal can be picked again.

Force_assets.line: Infantry (req 3; cost 6; HP 6; Magic None; atk F v. F / 1d8 damage; counter 1d6 damage; qualities -) — Common foot soldiers; rarely heroic, but they have the advantage of numbers.

Force_assets.name: Temple Fanatics
Force_assets.ability: After every time they defend or successfully attack, they take 1d4 damage.
Force_assets.line: Temple Fanatics (req 3; cost 4; HP 6; Magic None; atk F v. F / 2d6 damage; counter 2d6 damage; qualities Special) — After every time they defend or successfully attack, they take 1d4 damage.

Force_assets.name: Witch Hunters
Force_assets.ability: Trained to sniff out traitors, spies, and hostile or hidden spellcraft.
Force_assets.line: Witch Hunters (req 3; cost 6; HP 4; Magic Low; atk C v. C / 1d4+1 damage; counter 1d6 damage; qualities -) — Trained to sniff out traitors, spies, and hostile or hidden spellcraft.

Force_assets.name: Cavalry
Force_assets.ability: Mounted troops; weak on defense, but can harry logistics and mount charges.
Force_assets.line: Cavalry (req 4; cost 8; HP 12; Magic None; atk F v. F / 2d6 damage; counter 1d4 damage; qualities -) — Mounted troops; weak on defense, but can harry logistics and mount charges.

Force_assets.name: Military Roads
Force_assets.ability: Once/turn, pay 1 Treasure: move any one Asset from any location in reach to any other location in reach.
Force_assets.line: Military Roads (req 4; cost 10; HP 10; Magic None; atk -; counter -; qualities Action) — Once/turn, pay 1 Treasure: move any one Asset from any location in reach to any other location in reach.

Force_assets.name: Vanguard Unit
Force_assets.ability: On a Relocate action, move the Vanguard and allied units in its location to any location in range, even where a force is normally barred; they may remain after.
Force_assets.line: Vanguard Unit (req 4; cost 10; HP 10; Magic None; atk -; counter 1d6 damage; qualities Action) — On a Relocate action, move the Vanguard and allied units in its location to any location in range, even where a force is normally barred; they may remain after.

Force_assets.name: War Fleet
Force_assets.ability: Attacks only along waterways; once/turn may freely relocate to any coastal area in range. Must be based out of a landward supply location.
Force_assets.line: War Fleet (req 4; cost 12; HP 8; Magic None; atk F v. F / 2d6 damage; counter 1d8 damage; qualities Action) — Attacks only along waterways; once/turn may freely relocate to any coastal area in range. Must be based out of a landward supply location.

Force_assets.name: Demonic Slayer
Force_assets.ability: An inhuman assassin-beast that enters play Stealthed.
Force_assets.line: Demonic Slayer (req 5; cost 12; HP 4; Magic High; atk C v. C / 2d6+2 damage; counter -; qualities Subtle, Special) — An inhuman assassin-beast that enters play Stealthed.

Force_assets.name: Magical Logistics
Force_assets.ability: Once/turn, free action: repair 2 HP of damage to an allied Force Asset.
Force_assets.line: Magical Logistics (req 5; cost 14; HP 6; Magic Medium; atk -; counter -; qualities Special) — Once/turn, free action: repair 2 HP of damage to an allied Force Asset.

Force_assets.name: Siege Experts
Force_assets.ability: On a successful Attack, the target's owner loses 1d4 Treasure and this faction gains it.
Force_assets.line: Siege Experts (req 5; cost 10; HP 8; Magic None; atk F v. W / 1d6 damage; counter 1d6 damage; qualities -) — On a successful Attack, the target's owner loses 1d4 Treasure and this faction gains it.

Force_assets.name: Fortification Program
Force_assets.ability: Once/turn, when an enemy Attack targets the faction's Force, it may defend with this Asset if within one move of the attack.
Force_assets.line: Fortification Program (req 6; cost 20; HP 18; Magic None; atk -; counter 2d6 damage; qualities Action) — Once/turn, when an enemy Attack targets the faction's Force, it may defend with this Asset if within one move of the attack.

Force_assets.name: Knights
Force_assets.ability: Elite warriors of considerable personal prowess.
Force_assets.line: Knights (req 6; cost 18; HP 16; Magic None; atk F v. F / 2d8 damage; counter 2d6 damage; qualities -) — Elite warriors of considerable personal prowess.

Force_assets.name: War Machines
Force_assets.ability: Mobile war machines driven by trained beasts or magical motive power.
Force_assets.line: War Machines (req 6; cost 25; HP 14; Magic Medium; atk F v. F / 2d10+4 damage; counter 1d10 damage; qualities -) — Mobile war machines driven by trained beasts or magical motive power.

Force_assets.name: Brilliant General
Force_assets.ability: Whenever the General or any allied Force Asset in its location Attacks or defends, it rolls an extra die.
Force_assets.line: Brilliant General (req 7; cost 25; HP 8; Magic None; atk C v. F / 1d8 damage; counter -; qualities Subtle, Special) — Whenever the General or any allied Force Asset in its location Attacks or defends, it rolls an extra die.

Force_assets.name: Purity Rites
Force_assets.ability: Can only defend against Attacks that target the faction's Cunning, but allows an extra die to defend.
Force_assets.line: Purity Rites (req 7; cost 20; HP 10; Magic Low; atk -; counter 2d8+2 damage; qualities Special) — Can only defend against Attacks that target the faction's Cunning, but allows an extra die to defend.

Force_assets.name: Warshaped
Force_assets.ability: Magical war-creatures or greatly altered humans, few and elusive enough to evade easy detection.
Force_assets.line: Warshaped (req 7; cost 30; HP 16; Magic High; atk F v. F / 2d8+2 damage; counter 2d8 damage; qualities Subtle) — Magical war-creatures or greatly altered humans, few and elusive enough to evade easy detection.

Force_assets.name: Apocalypse Engine
Force_assets.ability: An unearthed ancient super-weapon that rains eldritch horror on a target.
Force_assets.line: Apocalypse Engine (req 8; cost 35; HP 20; Magic Medium; atk F v. F / 3d10+4 damage; counter -; qualities -) — An unearthed ancient super-weapon that rains eldritch horror on a target.

Force_assets.name: Invincible Legion
Force_assets.ability: On a Relocate action, can relocate where a formal army is normally barred, as if Subtle (though it is not subtle). Needs no support units to smash opposition.
Force_assets.line: Invincible Legion (req 8; cost 40; HP 30; Magic None; atk F v. F / 2d10+4 damage; counter 2d10+4 damage; qualities Special) — On a Relocate action, can relocate where a formal army is normally barred, as if Subtle (though it is not subtle). Needs no support units to smash opposition.

Wealth_assets.name: Armed Guards
Wealth_assets.ability: Hired caravan guards, bodyguards, or other armed minions.
Wealth_assets.line: Armed Guards (req 1; cost 1; HP 3; Magic None; atk W v. F / 1d3 damage; counter 1d4 damage; qualities -) — Hired caravan guards, bodyguards, or other armed minions.

Wealth_assets.name: Cooperative Businesses
Wealth_assets.ability: Any other faction creating an Asset in this location pays +1 Treasure; stacks.
Wealth_assets.line: Cooperative Businesses (req 1; cost 1; HP 2; Magic None; atk W v. W / 1d4-1 damage; counter -; qualities Subtle, Special) — Any other faction creating an Asset in this location pays +1 Treasure; stacks.

Wealth_assets.name: Farmers
Wealth_assets.ability: Once/turn, free action: roll 1d6; on 5+ gain 1 Treasure from the Farmers.
Wealth_assets.line: Farmers (req 1; cost 2; HP 4; Magic None; atk -; counter 1d4 damage; qualities Action) — Once/turn, free action: roll 1d6; on 5+ gain 1 Treasure from the Farmers.

Wealth_assets.name: Front Merchant
Wealth_assets.ability: On a successful Attack, the target faction loses 1 Treasure (if any) and the Front Merchant's owner gains it. Once/turn.
Wealth_assets.line: Front Merchant (req 1; cost 2; HP 3; Magic None; atk W v. W / 1d4 damage; counter 1d4-1 damage; qualities Subtle) — On a successful Attack, the target faction loses 1 Treasure (if any) and the Front Merchant's owner gains it. Once/turn.

Wealth_assets.name: Caravan
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn, spend 1 Treasure: move itself and one other Asset in its location to a new location within one move.
Wealth_assets.line: Caravan (req 2; cost 5; HP 4; Magic None; atk W v. W / 1d4 damage; counter -; qualities Action) — Free action, once/turn, spend 1 Treasure: move itself and one other Asset in its location to a new location within one move.

Wealth_assets.name: Dragomans
Wealth_assets.ability: A faction taking Expand Influence in its location rolls an extra die on all checks there that turn. Free action, once/turn, it can move.
Wealth_assets.line: Dragomans (req 2; cost 4; HP 4; Magic None; atk -; counter 1d4 damage; qualities Subtle, Special) — A faction taking Expand Influence in its location rolls an extra die on all checks there that turn. Free action, once/turn, it can move.

Wealth_assets.name: Pleaders
Wealth_assets.ability: Legal specialists who turn local law against enemies; can neither Attack nor inflict Counterattack damage on Force Assets.
Wealth_assets.line: Pleaders (req 2; cost 6; HP 4; Magic None; atk C v. W / 2d4 damage; counter 1d6 damage; qualities Special) — Legal specialists who turn local law against enemies; can neither Attack nor inflict Counterattack damage on Force Assets.

Wealth_assets.name: Worker Mob
Wealth_assets.ability: The roughest laborers, quietly organized to discipline the faction's enemies.
Wealth_assets.line: Worker Mob (req 2; cost 4; HP 6; Magic None; atk W v. F / 1d4+1 damage; counter 1d4 damage; qualities -) — The roughest laborers, quietly organized to discipline the faction's enemies.

Wealth_assets.name: Ancient Mechanisms
Wealth_assets.ability: When an Asset in its location rolls to make a profit (e.g. Farmers, Manufactory), it may roll twice and take the better result.
Wealth_assets.line: Ancient Mechanisms (req 3; cost 8; HP 4; Magic Medium; atk -; counter -; qualities Special) — When an Asset in its location rolls to make a profit (e.g. Farmers, Manufactory), it may roll twice and take the better result.

Wealth_assets.name: Arcane Laboratory
Wealth_assets.ability: The faction's Magic counts as one step higher for creating Assets in its location. Multiple labs stack the boost.
Wealth_assets.line: Arcane Laboratory (req 3; cost 6; HP 4; Magic None; atk -; counter -; qualities Special) — The faction's Magic counts as one step higher for creating Assets in its location. Multiple labs stack the boost.

Wealth_assets.name: Free Company
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn: move itself. Costs 1 Treasure upkeep each turn; if unpaid, roll 1d6 — 1-3 lost, 4-6 goes rogue and attacks the richest target. Repeats until back pay is paid or it is lost.
Wealth_assets.line: Free Company (req 3; cost 8; HP 6; Magic None; atk W v. F / 2d4+2 damage; counter 1d6 damage; qualities Action, Special) — Free action, once/turn: move itself. Costs 1 Treasure upkeep each turn; if unpaid, roll 1d6 — 1-3 lost, 4-6 goes rogue and attacks the richest target. Repeats until back pay is paid or it is lost.

Wealth_assets.name: Manufactory
Wealth_assets.ability: Once/turn, free action: roll 1d6 — 1 lose 1 Treasure, 2-5 gain 1, 6 gain 2. If owed Treasure can't be paid by turn's end, the Manufactory is lost.
Wealth_assets.line: Manufactory (req 3; cost 8; HP 4; Magic None; atk -; counter 1d4 damage; qualities Action) — Once/turn, free action: roll 1d6 — 1 lose 1 Treasure, 2-5 gain 1, 6 gain 2. If owed Treasure can't be paid by turn's end, the Manufactory is lost.

Wealth_assets.name: Healers
Wealth_assets.ability: When an Asset within one move is destroyed by an Attack that used Force against it, the owner may pay half its purchase price (round up) to restore it with 1 HP. Not usable on Bases of Influence.
Wealth_assets.line: Healers (req 4; cost 12; HP 8; Magic None; atk -; counter -; qualities Action) — When an Asset within one move is destroyed by an Attack that used Force against it, the owner may pay half its purchase price (round up) to restore it with 1 HP. Not usable on Bases of Influence.

Wealth_assets.name: Monopoly
Wealth_assets.ability: Once/turn, free action: target an Asset in its location; that owner must pay 1 Treasure or lose the targeted Asset.
Wealth_assets.line: Monopoly (req 4; cost 8; HP 12; Magic None; atk W v. W / 1d6 damage; counter 1d6 damage; qualities Action) — Once/turn, free action: target an Asset in its location; that owner must pay 1 Treasure or lose the targeted Asset.

Wealth_assets.name: Occult Countermeasures
Wealth_assets.ability: Can only Attack or inflict Counterattack damage on Assets that require at least Low Magic to purchase.
Wealth_assets.line: Occult Countermeasures (req 4; cost 10; HP 8; Magic Low; atk W v. C / 2d10 damage; counter 1d10 damage; qualities Special) — Can only Attack or inflict Counterattack damage on Assets that require at least Low Magic to purchase.

Wealth_assets.name: Usurers
Wealth_assets.ability: Each unit owned lowers the Treasure cost of buying Assets by 2 (min half cost); each use deals 1d4 damage to the Usurers from popular displeasure.
Wealth_assets.line: Usurers (req 4; cost 12; HP 8; Magic None; atk W v. W / 1d10 damage; counter -; qualities Action) — Each unit owned lowers the Treasure cost of buying Assets by 2 (min half cost); each use deals 1d4 damage to the Usurers from popular displeasure.

Wealth_assets.name: Mad Genius
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn: move. Free action, once/turn: be sacrificed to treat its location's Magic as High for buying the next Asset there.
Wealth_assets.line: Mad Genius (req 5; cost 6; HP 2; Magic None; atk W v. C / 1d6 damage; counter -; qualities Action) — Free action, once/turn: move. Free action, once/turn: be sacrificed to treat its location's Magic as High for buying the next Asset there.

Wealth_assets.name: Smuggling Fleet
Wealth_assets.ability: Once/turn, free action: move itself and one Asset in its location to any water-accessible location in one move; the moved Asset gains Subtle until it acts at the destination.
Wealth_assets.line: Smuggling Fleet (req 5; cost 12; HP 6; Magic None; atk W v. F / 2d6 damage; counter -; qualities Subtle, Action) — Once/turn, free action: move itself and one Asset in its location to any water-accessible location in one move; the moved Asset gains Subtle until it acts at the destination.

Wealth_assets.name: Supply Interruption
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn: make a Cunning vs. Wealth check against an Asset in its location; on success that owner must pay half the target's purchase cost or the Asset is disabled until paid.
Wealth_assets.line: Supply Interruption (req 5; cost 10; HP 8; Magic None; atk C v. W / 1d6 damage; counter -; qualities Subtle, Action) — Free action, once/turn: make a Cunning vs. Wealth check against an Asset in its location; on success that owner must pay half the target's purchase cost or the Asset is disabled until paid.

Wealth_assets.name: Economic Disruption
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn: move itself without cost.
Wealth_assets.line: Economic Disruption (req 6; cost 25; HP 10; Magic None; atk W v. W / 2d6 damage; counter -; qualities Subtle, Action) — Free action, once/turn: move itself without cost.

Wealth_assets.name: Merchant Prince
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn before buying an Asset in its location: the Merchant Prince takes 1d4 damage and that Asset costs 1d8 Treasure less (min half price).
Wealth_assets.line: Merchant Prince (req 6; cost 20; HP 10; Magic None; atk W v. W / 2d8 damage; counter 1d8 damage; qualities Action) — Free action, once/turn before buying an Asset in its location: the Merchant Prince takes 1d4 damage and that Asset costs 1d8 Treasure less (min half price).

Wealth_assets.name: Trade Company
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn: accept 1d4 damage to the Asset in exchange for 1d6-1 Treasure.
Wealth_assets.line: Trade Company (req 6; cost 15; HP 10; Magic None; atk W v. W / 2d6 damage; counter 1d6 damage; qualities Action) — Free action, once/turn: accept 1d4 damage to the Asset in exchange for 1d6-1 Treasure.

Wealth_assets.name: Ancient Workshop
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn: the Workshop takes 1d6 damage and the owner gains 1d6 Treasure.
Wealth_assets.line: Ancient Workshop (req 7; cost 25; HP 16; Magic Medium; atk -; counter -; qualities -) — Free action, once/turn: the Workshop takes 1d6 damage and the owner gains 1d6 Treasure.

Wealth_assets.name: Lead or Silver
Wealth_assets.ability: If its Attack reduces an enemy Asset to 0 HP, the owner may pay half the target's purchase cost to claim it, reviving it with 1 HP.
Wealth_assets.line: Lead or Silver (req 7; cost 20; HP 10; Magic None; atk W v. W / 2d10 damage; counter 2d8 damage; qualities -) — If its Attack reduces an enemy Asset to 0 HP, the owner may pay half the target's purchase cost to claim it, reviving it with 1 HP.

Wealth_assets.name: Transport Network
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, spend 1 Treasure: move any friendly Asset within two moves to any location within one move of either the target or the Network.
Wealth_assets.line: Transport Network (req 7; cost 15; HP 5; Magic None; atk W v. W / 1d12 damage; counter -; qualities Action) — Free action, spend 1 Treasure: move any friendly Asset within two moves to any location within one move of either the target or the Network.

Wealth_assets.name: Golden Prosperity
Wealth_assets.ability: Each turn, free action: gain 1d6 Treasure usable to fix damaged Assets as the Repair Assets action. Any unspent on repairs is lost.
Wealth_assets.line: Golden Prosperity (req 8; cost 40; HP 30; Magic Medium; atk -; counter 2d10 damage; qualities -) — Each turn, free action: gain 1d6 Treasure usable to fix damaged Assets as the Repair Assets action. Any unspent on repairs is lost.

Wealth_assets.name: Hired Legion
Wealth_assets.ability: Free action, once/turn: move. Costs 2 Treasure upkeep each turn or it goes rogue as a Free Company. Cannot be voluntarily sold or disbanded.
Wealth_assets.line: Hired Legion (req 8; cost 30; HP 20; Magic None; atk W v. F / 2d10+4 damage; counter 2d10 damage; qualities Action) — Free action, once/turn: move. Costs 2 Treasure upkeep each turn or it goes rogue as a Free Company. Cannot be voluntarily sold or disbanded.

example_goals.name: Blood the Enemy
example_goals.text: Inflict HP of damage on enemy faction assets/bases equal to your faction's total Force + Cunning + Wealth ratings.

example_goals.name: Destroy the Foe
example_goals.text: Destroy a rival faction. Difficulty equals 2 plus the average of the faction's Force, Cunning, and Wealth ratings.

example_goals.name: Eliminate Target
example_goals.text: Choose an undamaged rival Asset; destroy it within three turns. On failure, pick a new goal without the usual turn of paralysis.

example_goals.name: Expand Influence
example_goals.text: Plant a Base of Influence at a new location.

example_goals.name: Inside Enemy Territory
example_goals.text: Have a number of Stealthed assets in locations with a rival Base of Influence equal to your Cunning. Already-Stealthed units when the goal is adopted don't count.

example_goals.name: Invincible Valor
example_goals.text: Destroy a Force asset whose minimum purchase rating is higher than your faction's Force rating.

example_goals.name: Peaceable Kingdom
example_goals.text: Don't take an Attack action for four turns.

example_goals.name: Root Out the Enemy
example_goals.text: Destroy a Base of Influence of a rival faction in a specific location.

example_goals.name: Sphere Dominance
example_goals.text: Choose Wealth, Force, or Cunning; destroy a number of rival assets of that kind equal to your score in it.

example_goals.name: Wealth of Kingdoms
example_goals.text: Spend Treasure equal to four times your Wealth on bribes and influence (lost). Wealth must rise before this goal can be picked again.
